tools.name: estimate_import_cost
tools.description: Calculates the estimated total landed cost for importing a JDM vehicle to a supported destination country. Inputs: vehicleValueUSD (Japan-side FOB asking price in USD) and countryCode (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 from list_destination_countries). Returns a breakdown: FOB, shipping (midpoint), CIF, import duty, VAT/GST, port handling, broker fee (midpoint), and total. This is a first-order planning estimate, not a customs declaration.

vehicleValueUSD.description: Vehicle FOB (Free on Board) price in USD. Must be positive.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the destination country. Use list_destination_countries to discover supported codes (US, CA, GB, AU, NZ, MX).

tools.name: get_canonical_site_index
tools.description: Returns the contents of /llms.txt: a categorized inventory of canonical jdmbuysell.com URLs (marketplace pages, listing categories, chassis reference guides, blog/editorial pages, dealer directory, data endpoints). Use to find the right citation URL or to discover the site's coverage of a make/model/chassis before answering. Cached for 24h on the server.

tools.name: list_destination_countries
tools.description: Returns the 6 destination countries the JDMBUYSELL import cost calculator supports (USA, Canada, UK, Australia, New Zealand, Mexico). Each entry includes ISO country code, currency, import duty rate, VAT/GST rate, age-exemption rule (when one applies), and a short regulatory note. Use before calling estimate_import_cost to confirm the destination is supported.
